usuarios.correos.verificacion.asunto: Code to confirm your email address
usuarios.correos.verificacion.cuerpo:
To confirm this email address, enter this code in “My preferences”:

{codigo}

The code is valid for {minutos} minutes and can only be used once.

If you did not ask for this code, you do not need to do anything: without it, nobody can use this address to get our notifications.

Human Resources. Diputación de Granada
usuarios.correos.aviso_cambio.asunto: Your email address for notifications has changed
usuarios.correos.aviso_cambio.cuerpo:
From now on we will send your notifications to another address that you confirmed in “My preferences”. This address stays on your list but will no longer receive notifications.

If you did not make this change, please tell Human Resources as soon as possible.

Human Resources. Diputación de Granada
